origin.basis: Schwalbe is the brand of Ralf Bohle GmbH, Reichshof, Germany (legal notice).

manufacturing.basis: The Schwalbe product pages do not state where the tire is made.

availability.note: Schwalbe's European and North American sites give recommended retail prices and send buyers to retailers; mainland China availability not verified.

name: One Tubeless
positioning: Tubeless-easy version of the Schwalbe One all-round road tire with RaceGuard.
caveats: Schwalbe states no hookless approval on these product pages.
The 2020 lab test of the earlier One TLE Performance is not applied.

price_observations.conditions: Recommended retail price on the official product page on 2026-11-01; one tire; retailer prices vary.
